changeSet.author: ged
changeSet.comment: Séquence et déclencheurs du compteur de version des habilitations.
changeSet.sql: CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS ${database.defaultSchemaName}.version_habilitations_seq START WITH 1

CREATE TRIGGER trg_noeud_version_habilitations AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION ${database.defaultSchemaName}.incrementer_version_habilitations()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_habilitation_version_habilitations AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.habilitation FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION ${database.defaultSchemaName}.incrementer_version_habilitations()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_groupe_membre_version_habilitations AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.groupe_membre FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION ${database.defaultSchemaName}.incrementer_version_habilitations()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_groupe_ged_version_habilitations AFTER UPDATE OR DELETE ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.groupe_ged FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION ${database.defaultSchemaName}.incrementer_version_habilitations()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_role_permission_version_habilitations AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.role_permission FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION ${database.defaultSchemaName}.incrementer_version_habilitations()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_role_version_habilitations AFTER UPDATE OR DELETE ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.role FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION ${database.defaultSchemaName}.incrementer_version_habilitations()
